name: Lotus
look: Lotus throne barrier from cultivation fantasy. Large translucent pink-white lotus petals of light rise round the character and close into a tall bud, a soft glow inside.
subject: shield

rows.name: INIT
rows.caption: shield forms
rows.text: petals rise from a lotus pad under the character's feet and fold up into the closed bud

rows.name: IDLE
rows.caption: shield holds
rows.text: the bud holds, its petals breathing slightly and specks of light rising inside; it loops

rows.name: HIT
rows.caption: blow lands from the right
rows.text: a blow strikes from the right; the petals on that side shiver and flash, a puff of glowing pollen bursts out to the right

rows.name: BREAK
rows.caption: shield ends
rows.text: the bud opens wide and its petals detach and drift away, fading
